g.text: Absolute coefficient magnitude is not signed allocation
Mean of absolute local coefficients (not absolute of the signed mean). Heads remain separate; source time is not read time. The corresponding signed
maps and all-read source2 maps remain in raw arrays and the offline viewer. These quantities describe local memory reads, not patch-to-patch
